cat.note: A small cat curled on its feet: a furry body, rounded in from its outline like the other animals.

hand-lantern.note: A torch held at an angle: the wooden handle is rounded, and the flame at its head gives its own light, so it faces the camera and is never relit.

arcane-stone.note: A polished blank grey stone seen from above: a round orb with a painted highlight, rounded in from its outline.

basic-bag.note: A cloth pouch tied at the neck: soft and rounded.

leather-backpack.note: A leather backpack lying on the ground: a stiff body, rounded at its edges.

berry.note: Two berries on a stem: small spheres.

stale-berry.note: Two shrivelled berries on a stem: small spheres.

red-potion.note: A round glass bottle of red liquid with a cork: rounded like a flask.

green-potion.note: A round glass bottle of green liquid with a cork: rounded like a flask.

luminous-potion.note: A round glass bottle of blue liquid with a cork: rounded like a flask.

empty-bottle.note: An empty glass bottle with a cork: only its outline and cork are drawn, rounded like a flask.

ale.note: A tankard of ale with a head of foam: a cylinder standing upright.

bread.note: A loaf of bread: rounded crust.

raw-meat.note: A raw joint of meat on the bone: a rounded lump.

cooked-meat.note: A cooked joint of meat on the bone: a rounded lump.

rotten-meat.note: A rotten joint of meat on the bone: a rounded lump.

cheese.note: A wedge of cheese: rounded in from its outline, which is close enough for a wedge this small.

stale-cheese.note: A mouldy wedge of cheese: rounded in from its outline.

apple.note: An apple with a leaf: a sphere.

apple-pie.note: A slice of apple pie: a rounded crust.

arcane-shard.note: A cut crystal lying on the ground: its facets are too small to draw separately, so it is rounded in from its outline.

arcane-bolt.note: A projectile drawn with arcane-shard's sprite, so it shares the shard's normals: rounded in from its outline.

verdant-light.note: A projectile drawn with arcane-shard's sprite, so it shares the shard's normals: rounded in from its outline.

sack.note: A tied sack of grain, two cells across: soft and rounded.

skull-troll.note: A skull lying on the ground: a rounded dome.

skull-player.note: A skull lying on the ground: a rounded dome.

fireball.note: A fireball in flight: it is all flame and gives its own light, so it faces the camera and is never relit.

thrown-stone.note: A thrown stone: a rounded lump.

bubble.note: A water bubble in flight: a sphere with painted highlights. It gives no light, so it is relit like any rounded body.

skin.note: An animal hide lying flat on the ground.
